चिक्षुर

CIKṢURA . War minister of Mahiṣāsura. tāmra was his finance minister, asiloma prime minister, biḍāla foreign minister, Ubharka Commander-in-chief, śukra, minister for education and bāṣkala, trinetra and kālabandhaka consulting ministers. (devī bhāgavata, Pañcama skandha).

चिकुर

CIKURA . Son of āryaka, the serpent king. cikura had a son called sumukha. Once garuḍa ate cikura for food. (M.B. Udyoga Parva, Chapter 120, Verse 23).
